reviewed_by: Codex PR #750 conflict review against main, 2026-10-13
reason: The changed journey opens a parent project's Work page, sees its board and selected item before the searchable subproject list, then searches a child project and saves and reloads a Work update. The URL identifies the project and selected item; Core owns Work records and the subproject relationship; React owns only the transient search text. The board must precede subproject search at desktop and mobile widths, including when an item is selected, while existing navigation and check-ins remain usable. Select the 14 WorkPage component cases and the single catalogued real-Core Work journey in each of the 8 permanent desktop Chromium and emulated mobile Chromium/WebKit profiles. The real-Core journey uses a production UI bundle on a non-loopback LAN origin, creates a subproject and item, and checks order, update, refresh, reconnect, and accessibility. The main branch changed the shared real-core.spec.ts file after this PR opened; its merged Work hunk and pairing helper were reviewed against current main. The previous post-pairing readiness assertion landed on an unconfigured terminal, so the focused journey uses the established pairing helper, opens Projects, then selects the project row and Work tab. A 12 px layout margin keeps the selected-item panel and following subproject section separated after reordering.
exclusions: No Python or Rust source changed; backend and native tests are excluded. Streaming, interrupt, and deletion are outside this presentation-order change. No browser security or device-only API changed; the production LAN run checks layout and existing persistence behavior. Physical devices are unavailable. Other Playwright areas and full suites are excluded.
